cooling.title: Cooling
cooling.readOnly: ChromaFlow is setting fan %. If it exits, the board takes over.
cooling.conflict: Another fan daemon is present: {names}. ChromaFlow will not take PWM.
cooling.noTakeover: Take-over is blocked while coolercontrold or fancontrol is running.
cooling.needsNative: Fan duty apply needs the native ChromaFlow window.
cooling.takeoverAsk: ChromaFlow will run your fans until you turn this off. If the app stops, the motherboard takes over. Continue?
cooling.zeroAsk: Minimum 0% can stop the fans. Continue?
cooling.quietHelp: Locked preset. Stays near 20% until the sensor is hot, then ramps to 100% by 90 °C.
cooling.balancedHelp: Locked preset. Even climb from 20% at 30 °C to 100% at 85 °C.
cooling.performanceHelp: Locked preset. Already 35% at 30 °C and full speed by 75 °C.
cooling.fullHelp: Flat 100% so you can tell which header is which. Uncheck AIO unit, pick 100% on one fan, then take over only that fan. RPM on the card updates about once a second.
cooling.applyAllAria: Apply this curve to all fans
cooling.customHelp: Cloned curve. Change the points; Quiet, Balanced, Performance, and 100% stay locked.
cooling.calibrateNone: No fans or pumps with writable PWM.
cooling.noTach: No tach (RPM stayed 0). Table left empty.
lighting.title: Lighting
lighting.sandbox: OpenRGB is sandboxed (Flatpak/bwrap) and often cannot see USB RGB. Use native openrgb --server --server-host 127.0.0.1.
lighting.tip.r: Red. How much red is in the color (0 = none, 255 = full).
lighting.tip.g: Green. How much green is in the color (0 = none, 255 = full).
lighting.tip.b: Blue. How much blue is in the color (0 = none, 255 = full).
lighting.tip.h: Hue. The color family around the rainbow (red, yellow, green, cyan, blue, magenta).
lighting.tip.s: Saturation. How vivid the color is (0 = gray, 255 = full color).
lighting.tip.v: Value (brightness). How light or dark (0 = black, 255 = bright).
lighting.tip.k: Kelvin. Color temperature of white light: low is warm candle or sunset, high is cool daylight (2000–6500 K on this slider).
lighting.tip.hex: Six-digit web color code, like #ff890e. Same color as the sliders, written for copy/paste.
lighting.applyNeedGui: Live color apply needs chromaflow-gui (not the Vite preview).
lighting.researchHelp: USB HID that still has no Linux write path after OpenRGB, liquidctl, and known VID:PID backends. Report opens a GitHub issue labelled device. Maintainers process that inbox into udev and backends here. Serial is not included.
lighting.reportConfirm: Copy this device’s IDs (no serial) and open a GitHub issue?
lighting.reportOpened: Report copied. GitHub issue form opened.
lighting.reportPasted: Report copied. The GitHub URL was too long, so paste the body into the form.
lighting.engineMissing: The lighting engine is not in this install. It ships in the ChromaFlow package.
lighting.engineInstalled: Lighting engine saved. Re-open Lighting if devices do not appear.
lighting.reason.not_in_openrgb: Not in the OpenRGB SDK list
lighting.tip.speed: How fast the host effect moves. 1 is slow, 128 is QMK default, 255 is fastest.
lighting.tip.gaugeSpeed: Speed does not change hardware gauges. Color follows temperature or usage and the green–red or blue–red toggle on the Hardware cube.
lighting.gaugeSpectrum: Left is cool or empty. Right is hot or full. Green–red goes through yellow. Blue–red goes through magenta. Temp uses 25–90 °C. Usage uses 0–100%.
lighting.gaugeMetric: LED color follows temperature or usage
lighting.gaugePalette: LED colors from green to red or blue to red
lighting.gaugesRoute: Motherboard and CPU AIO follow CPU. GPU shroud follows GPU. Keyboard and speakers follow combined CPU+GPU. Combined on All devices paints every lamp. RAM and disk paint every device.
lighting.effectHint: Effects every lamp can run. Rainbows are keyboard and speakers only.
lighting.noEffects: No devices to apply that effect to.
lighting.ledHelp: Click a key or LED to apply the current color. Hide the layout to keep the picker simple.
profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.help: Apply sets fans and lights to this look.
profiles.name: Name
profiles.applied: Fans and lights match this look.
profiles.applyNeedGui: Apply needs the native ChromaFlow window.
support.title: Support
support.toolbox: Install all asks for your password once.
support.installed: Detection support installed. Log out of Cinnamon if groups or udev changed.
support.applyNeedGui: Install needs chromaflow-gui so pkexec can show the password dialog.
support.competitorsHelp: Other fan apps will fight this one. Uninstall is optional and needs a password.
support.competitorsNone: No competing fan or RGB controllers are installed.
support.competitorsConfirm: Uninstall the listed fan and RGB controllers? This uses apt purge. OpenRGB and ChromaFlow stay installed.
support.competitorsRemoved: Competing controllers uninstalled. Re-scan inventory if the conflict banner is still visible.
support.updateNone: No Linux package is on this release.
support.updateRate: GitHub rate limit. Try again later.
support.updateBad: The release listing was not usable.
support.updateInstalled: Installed. Close ChromaFlow and open it again.
support.updateHelper: Open the package download, finish install, then reopen.
